content: Minimalist personal-site examples (Colorlib, Wix roundups) succeed via restraint applied deliberately: one strong typographic voice, generous whitespace, a single accent, and work presented as a clean grid/list rather than via copy. Minimalism reads as 'unfinished' when the restraint appears to be an absence of decisions (no type hierarchy, default template look, empty states with no content) rather than a visible, consistent system.
